The structure of V6S8 (reduced formula V3S4) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows one V orbit with 5 geometric neighbors (4 S, 1 V; 2.34–2.47 Å) and another V orbit with 6 S neighbors at 2.47 Å; S centers adopt 3- and 4-coordinate environments. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner- and edge-sharing between 5-vertex V polyhedra and corner-sharing between 6-vertex S polyhedra, forming a 3-dimensional connected network.
